summary: The source contract caps the array at 50 elements, so legal scaling cannot reliably separate linear Fisher-Yates work from a quadratic shrinking-list shuffle. Fisher-Yates visits and emits each of the n values once per call, matching the output-size lower bound.

replacement_checks.evidence: reset copies exactly n values. shuffle copies n values and performs exactly n - 1 constant-time random choices and swaps, while any returned array necessarily contains n values. The object retains one n-element snapshot.

The certificate regression exercises one-element and 50-element arrays, verifies every Fisher-Yates choice range under deterministic endpoint selection, checks permutation and reset-copy invariants, and runs the source maximum of 10,000 public calls for both app-local and native classes.
